title: Introducing Our Public Product Roadmap
summary: Our new public roadmap offers a clear view of recently completed features, upcoming developments, and future plans for Noeko.

title: Seamlessly Interactive Checkboxes
summary: We've made checkboxes bigger, easier to click, and fully draggable, giving you a smooth and modern task management experience.

title: Enhanced Real-time Collaboration
summary: Experience smoother teamwork with clearer indicators, so you always know who's working on what and your document stays perfectly updated.

title: Enhanced File Control & Management
summary: Gain unprecedented control over your documents and images by effortlessly managing, adding, and customizing how they display directly within the editor for a more polished and professional look.

title: Unlock Your Knowledge: Advanced Search and Curation
summary: Effortlessly discover and curate your knowledge with advanced filtering by tags and time, dynamic sorting, and the ability to save refined results into personalized Compendiums.

title: Flexible Content Display
summary: Effortlessly organize your thoughts and enhance note clarity with new flexible display options for all your linked content.

title: Unleash Noeko: Self-Hosting & Premium Features
summary: Get ready for Noeko's public debut, featuring flexible self-hosting and robust new paid plans that empower you with choice and enhanced functionality for your projects.

title: A World of Themes: New & Improved Visuals
summary: Get ready for a beautiful new look as we enhance existing themes and unveil a collection of stunning new options to perfectly match your aesthetic.
